body.name: Empirical-multinomial branch plug-in estimator
body.construction: On \(\widehat p_N\in\mathcal U\), set \(\widehat Q_N=\widetilde F_S(\widehat p_N)\) and use the Jacobian plug-in covariance \(\widehat\Sigma_F\); outside \(\mathcal U\), set \(\widehat Q_N(c_y;c_x)=1/|\mathcal A_Y|\) for every \((c_x,c_y)\) and \(\widehat\Sigma_F=0\). In both cases define \(\mathcal W_N\) from these total objects. At the population law, the influence vector is \(\psi_p(a)=J_F(p)(e_a-p)\) and the covariance is \(\Sigma_F(p)\).
